Who can apply for this Program?

Applicants must not currently own a property in Dubai.
Applicants can either be UAE Nationals or Residents living in UAE.

Emirates NBD reserves the right to evaluate applications based on its credit policies.

DET First Time Home Buyers Program

How does the Program Work?

Step 1

Eligible residents register with Dubai Land Department (DLD)

Step 2

DLD reviews the applications.

Step 3

If customers are approved by DLD, they will be informed and added to approved customer list by DLD.

Step 4

Eligible customers’ information will be shared with developers for communication ahead of project launches.

Step 5

Customers who show interest to any developer’s project then initiates the process for purchase of the property, then start mortgage process with Emirates NBD.

Key benefits and highlights*

  • Apply with a minimum salary of  10,000 for UAE Nationals
  • Apply with a minimum salary of  15,000 for Expatriates
  • Available for salaried and self-employed individuals
  • Finance up to 85% of the Property Value for UAE Nationals
  • Finance up to 80% of the Property Value for Expatriates
  • Life insurance options available
  • No application fee
  • Free partial settlement, up to 20% of the loan amount
  • Chance to apply with a co-borrower

Purchasing Process for an Off-Plan Properties

  • Partnered developers can see list of customers who have shown interest into their projects.
  • For any planned launches developers reach out to eligible customers to inform them about the project and dedicated units for FTH Program.
  • If customers were to show interest in project, then they submit EOI and books their property.
  • Following booking completion, developer completes “Oqood” registration in DLD system.
  • Customers who become property owners, are removed from the system by DLD.

Purchasing Process for Ready Properties

  • Customers shortlist a ready property from secondary market.
  • Customers wishes to finance their purchase, with Home Loan from Emirates NBD, reaches out to bank
  • Bank representatives checks whether the customers are verified participants of the program
  • If customers are verified through DLD portal, bank provides the special offer to applicant.
